[[Tamil Nadu Energy Development Agency]] | founded = 2024 | hq_location = [[Chennai]], [[Tamil Nadu]], India | area_served = Tamil Nadu | key_people = {{Unbulleted list | Dr. J Radhakrishnan IAS [[Chairman]] | Dr. Aneesh Sekhar IAS [[Managing Director|MD]] }} | revenue = {{Increase}}{{INRConvert|1607.11|c}} (2024–25){{cite web |url=https://www.tngecl.org/static/greenenergy/assets/files/linkpdf/financials/AnnualReport2425indas.pdf |title=Annual Report 2024-25 |publisher=TNGECL |access-date=18 March 2026}} | operating_income = {{Increase}}{{INRConvert|588.22|c}} (2024–25) | net_income = {{Increase}}{{INRConvert|242.27|c}} (2024–25) | assets = {{Increase}}{{INRConvert|81526.69|c}} (2024–25) | equity = {{Increase}}{{INRConvert|-1125.31|c}} (2024–25) | parent = [[TNEB Limited]] | products = [[Electricity]] | services = Power generation (renewable), hydro generation, solar, wind, energy storage | website = {{URL|https://www.tngecl.org/}} }} '''Tamil Nadu Green Energy Corporation Limited''' ('''TNGECL''') is a state-owned renewable energy company of the Government of Tamil Nadu. It was established in 2024 following the restructuring of [[Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Limited]] (TANGEDCO) to focus exclusively on renewable energy development including hydro, solar, wind and energy storage projects.{{cite web |title=Energy Policy Note 2024–25 |url=https://cms.tn.gov.in/cms_migrated/document/docfiles/energy_e_pn_2024_25.pdf |publisher=Government of Tamil Nadu}} The company was formed by transferring the renewable energy activities of TANGEDCO and merging the [[Tamil Nadu Energy Development Agency]] (TEDA) into the new corporation.{{Cite web|url=https://www.saurenergy.com/solar-energy-news/tamil-nadu-forms-new-green-company-tngecl-from-teda-and-tangedco|title=Tamil Nadu Forms New Green Company TNGECL From TEDA And Tangedco|first=Akash|last=Dhiman|website=www.saurenergy.com}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/tn-approves-plan-to-create-new-distribution-generation-green-energy-companies-replacing-tangedco-teda-765231|title=TN approves plan to create new distribution, generation & green energy companies replacing Tangedco, TEDA|publisher=DTNEXT|date=February 2, 2024|website=DT Next}} TNGECL operates as a subsidiary of [[Tamil Nadu Electricity Board]] (TNEB) and is responsible for expanding renewable energy capacity as part of Tamil Nadu's clean energy transition.{{cite web |title=Energy Policy Note 2025–26 |url=https://cms.tn.gov.in/cms_migrated/document/docfiles/energy_e_pn_2025_26.pdf |publisher=Government of Tamil Nadu}} ==History== Electricity generation in Tamil Nadu was historically managed by the Tamil Nadu Electricity Board. In 2010, the board was reorganised into TNEB Limited with operational subsidiaries.https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/Tamil-Nadu-Electricity-Board-overhaul-on-target/article16297851.ece In January 2024, the Government of Tamil Nadu approved further restructuring of TANGEDCO into separate generation, distribution and renewable energy companies to improve operational efficiency and accelerate renewable energy adoption. As part of this reform Renewable energy activities were transferred to TNGECL{{cite web |title=Power sector restructuring Tamil Nadu |url=https://www.icra.in/Rating/GetRationalReportFilePdf?id=136056}} TNGECL also absorbed the functions of TEDA, which had previously served as the nodal renewable energy promotion agency of the state.{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/tn-forms-new-green-company-by-merging-teda-and-tangedcos-renewable-energy-wing/article67804453.ece|title=T.N. forms new green company by merging TEDA and Tangedco’s renewable energy wing|publisher=The Hindu|date=February 2, 2024|via=www.thehindu.com}} ==Operations== TNGECL is responsible for development and management of renewable energy projects including hydroelectric stations, solar parks, wind farms and storage systems.{{cite web |title=Energy Department Policy Note |url=https://cms.tn.gov.in}} The company also implements decentralised solar programmes and supports renewable energy procurement initiatives.{{cite news |title=TNGECL to procure solar power from farmers |work=The Times of India}} ==Renewable Energy Installed Capacity== As of 2024, Renewable Energy Installed Capacity is 25,269.35 MW {| class="wikitable" |+ Renewable energy installed capacity{{cite web |url=https://www.tngecl.org/en/greenenergy/generation/ |title=Generation – Tamil Nadu Green Energy Corporation Limited |publisher=TNGECL |access-date=18 March 2026}} ! extract:
Tamil Nadu Green Energy Corporation Limited (TNGECL) is a state-owned renewable energy company of the Government of Tamil Nadu. It was established in 2024 following the restructuring of Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Limited (TANGEDCO) to focus exclusively on renewable energy development including hydro, solar, wind and energy storage projects.
The company was formed by transferring the renewable energy activities of TANGEDCO and merging the Tamil Nadu Energy Development Agency (TEDA) into the new corporation.
TNGECL operates as a subsidiary of Tamil Nadu Electricity Board (TNEB) and is responsible for expanding renewable energy capacity as part of Tamil Nadu's clean energy transition.
